blocks.text: Grandis, Inc. was founded in 2002 by Dr. Paul Nguyen and Bill Almon and was backed by venture capital firms such as Sevin Rosen Funds and Matrix Partners to pioneer non-volatile solutions based on spintronics. The company developed thin-film memory, which included the invention of spin-transfer torque – random-access memory (STT-RAM).
The surname Grandis may refer to:

items: Jocelyn de Grandis, a French Olympic archer
Renato de Grandis (1927–2008), an Italian composer, musicologist, and writer
